name: cinema_and_theatre_review_taxonomy
description: Taxonomy of editorial domains, topics, and claim types for Cinema & Theatre Review.

domains.description: International auteur cinema, film festivals, film history, and criticism
Contemporary international stage productions, playwrights, and dramaturgy
Film preservation, 4K/photochemical restorations, cinematheques, and library archives
Critical monographs, dramatic texts, academic journals, and anthologies
Theoretical essays, roundtables, and in-depth critical assessments

claim_types.description: Inclusion of a film in a festival program or official competition
Official conferral of a festival or institutional award
Official opening or staging of a theatrical production
Official publication release of a monograph or dramatic text
Completion and premiere of an archival restoration or scan
Formal critical review or essay evaluation by recognized journal
Acquisition or theatrical distribution licensing agreement
Appointment of artistic director or curator at major institution
Commencement of principal photography or formal rehearsal
Official world, international, or festival premiere date of a film
Official selection of a documentary film in a specialized festival competition
Official scheduled festival programme announcement for performing arts
Confirmed venue performance run and staging dates for theatre
Curated jury selection of remarkable stage productions
First edition or definitive publication of a dramatic play text
Bibliographic metadata, DOI, ISBN, and library holdings control
Peer-reviewed scholarly study, dramaturgy analysis, or theoretical treatise
Professional stage review and critical reception of a theatrical production
Official festival report, debrief, or institutional announcement
Historical cinema and theatre restoration context, retrospective background, and archival heritage
